净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Uses 126-bar signed path efficiency as the core directional persistence signal and applies a bounded, continuous 63-bar confirmation weight. Recent efficiency magnitude controls the strength of the adjustment, while tanh-based directional agreement modestly boosts aligned trends and attenuates opposing trends without creating a binary gate or adding a separate feature family.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

-(E_t * [1 + 0.25 * sqrt(|E^(63)_t|) * tanh(5 E_t E^(63)_t)], where E_t is 126-bar signed path efficiency)
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📚 字段与算子释义

输入字段

字段含义说明
open开盘价基础行情字段
high最高价基础行情字段
low最低价基础行情字段
close收盘价基础行情字段
volume成交量基础行情字段
efficiency效率效率

算子

算子含义
sqrtsqrt(x) → 平方根
tanhtanh(x) → 双曲正切，将值压到 (-1, 1)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 net_move：close - close.shift(126)
  3. 计算 path_length：close.diff().abs().滚动窗口(126, min_periods=126).sum()
  4. 计算 efficiency：net_move / path_length
  5. 计算 recent_net_move：close - close.shift(63)
  6. 计算 recent_path_length：close.diff().abs().滚动窗口(63, min_periods=63).sum()
  7. 计算 recent_efficiency：recent_net_move / recent_path_length
  8. 计算 recent_magnitude：np.sqrt(recent_efficiency.abs().clip(lower=0.0))
  9. 计算 directional_agreement：np.tanh(5.0 * efficiency * recent_efficiency)
  10. 计算 confirmation_weight：1.0 + 0.25 * recent_magnitude * directional_agreement
  11. 计算 signal：efficiency * confirmation_weight
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_signed_path_efficiency_soft_confirmation(df): """Measure persistent directional phases with softened directional confirmation.""" df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["close"] net_move = close - close.shift(126) path_length = close.diff().abs().rolling(126, min_periods=126).sum() efficiency = net_move / path_length.replace(0.0, np.nan) recent_net_move = close - close.shift(63) recent_path_length = close.diff().abs().rolling(63, min_periods=63).sum() recent_efficiency = recent_net_move / recent_path_length.replace(0.0, np.nan) recent_magnitude = np.sqrt(recent_efficiency.abs().clip(lower=0.0)) directional_agreement = np.tanh(5.0 * efficiency * recent_efficiency) confirmation_weight = 1.0 + 0.25 * recent_magnitude * directional_agreement signal = efficiency * confirmation_weight df_copy["factor_signed_path_efficiency_soft_confirmation"] = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_signed_path_efficiency_soft_confirmation"]
